name: read_session_file
description: Read a file from a session's filesystem by path (absolute, or relative to an optional cwd). Returns the file contents as base64-encoded data along with its content type and size.

cwd.description: The base directory for resolving relative paths. If not specified, paths are resolved from the sandbox home directory.

path.description: The path of the file to read. Can be absolute or relative to the working directory.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session to read the file from.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
